_note: Voice bake-off script. [tags] in square brackets are only used by Chatterbox Turbo; other engines strip them.

kip.design: Young adult male voice in his late twenties. Bright, warm and energetic, slightly raspy, fast-talking and very expressive. Friendly, natural American accent.
kip.reference_text: Hey, it's Kip. Every day I find out something wild about the stuff we see all the time, and honestly, it never gets old. Let's see what today's story is.

dex.design: Adult male voice in his late thirties. Low, calm and smooth, with a dry deadpan delivery and precise articulation. Subtle British accent.
dex.reference_text: This is Dex. I check the facts, I bring the sources, and I try very hard not to be impressed. Today, I will probably fail at that.

excited.instruct: excited, energetic, fast-paced, smiling while talking

mindblown.instruct: utterly shocked and amazed, loud, voice rising in disbelief

amused.instruct: laughing a little, delighted and amused

dry.instruct: dry and sarcastic, with a tired, slightly amused sigh

lines.speaker: kip
lines.text: Okay. You know the lead in your pencil? There is no lead in it. At all!

lines.speaker: dex
lines.text: Actually, it's graphite. Mixed with clay. Two sources, Kip.

lines.speaker: kip
lines.text: And here's the part nobody tells you...

lines.speaker: dex
lines.text: [sigh] You say that every single day.
